name: Heart. Marrow. Blood.
source:
In Marrow City, a woman embarks on a venture to the City's Heart. A Tagalong joins her, an observer to her journey. A Knight commits murder for the very last time. A TV Broadcast reports without seeing, staying with them until the very end.

Promise to Remember, the City loves all.

[From [url=https://heartsyncproductions.itch.io/heart-marrow-blood]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在骨髓城，一名妇女踏上了前往城市中心的冒险之旅。一只塔加隆加入了她，成为她旅程的观察者。一名骑士最后一次犯下谋杀罪。电视广播在没有看到的情况下进行报道，并陪着他们直到最后。

承诺记住，这座城市爱所有人。

[来自[url=https://heartsyncproductions.itch.io/heart-marrow-blood]itch.io[/url]]
